segments.zh: SpaceX is now selling weightlessness,
by the ton.
Meet Starfall: a flying saucer,
about three meters wide.
It carries up to a thousand kilograms of cargo
segments.en: 它能带最多一千公斤的货

segments.zh: up to orbit and back home.
It just hit the Hacker News front page,
segments.en: 它刚上了 Hacker News 首页，

segments.zh: and people cannot stop arguing about it.
Today's brain teaser: up there, gravity is still about ninety percent as strong.
segments.en: 今天的烧脑问题：在轨道上，重力还有地面的九成。

segments.zh: So why does everything float?
Meet our hero, Saucy,
a flat little capsule with a big job.
The old way to get weightless:
drop something down a tall tower.
You get a few seconds of float.
Then, crunch.
Or ride a plane that dives like a roller coaster.
segments.en: 老办法二：坐飞机像过山车一样俯冲，

segments.zh: About twenty seconds of float, then everyone feels heavy again.
segments.en: 飘大约二十秒，然后又变沉。

segments.zh: SpaceX says Starfall gives you weeks of it.
segments.en: SpaceX 说，Starfall 能给你好几周。

segments.zh: Not seconds. Weeks.
Twist one: there is gravity in orbit.
At the space station, it is about ninety percent of what you feel here.
segments.en: 空间站那儿，重力还有地面的九成左右。

segments.zh: Astronauts float because they are falling.
segments.en: 宇航员飘着，是因为他们在往下掉，

segments.zh: All the time.
Picture Newton's cannon on a mountain.
segments.en: 想象山顶上有门牛顿大炮，

segments.zh: Fire a ball, and it curves down to the ground.
Fire faster, it lands farther.
Fire fast enough, and the ground curves away as fast as the ball falls.
segments.en: 快到一定程度，地面弯下去的速度跟球掉的一样快。

segments.zh: That is an orbit:
falling forever, and always missing.
segments.en: 永远在掉，永远掉不到地上。

segments.zh: In low orbit, that is about twenty eight thousand kilometers an hour.
segments.en: 低轨道大约每小时两万八千公里，

segments.zh: Fast enough to cross America in about ten minutes.
segments.en: 我们算了下，十分钟左右横穿美国。

segments.zh: When you and your lab fall together,
nothing presses on anything. That is weightless.
segments.en: 谁也压不着谁，这就是失重。

segments.zh: So why pay for falling?
Twist two: gravity messes up tiny crystals.
segments.en: 反转二：重力会把小晶体搅乱。

segments.zh: Drug makers grow crystals of proteins
segments.en: 药厂要把蛋白质长成晶体，

segments.zh: to see their shape and design medicine.
segments.en: 看清它的形状，才好做药。

segments.zh: On Earth, warm liquid rises and cool liquid sinks.
segments.en: 在地面上，热的液体往上走，冷的往下沉，

segments.zh: That churning is called convection.
It is like a pot of soup that never stops churning.
segments.en: 就像一锅一直在翻滚的汤，

segments.zh: The crystals come out lumpy.
In free fall, warm liquid has no up to rise toward.
segments.en: 一起自由下落时，热液体没有“上”可去，

segments.zh: The soup goes calm.
SpaceX says the crystals then grow smaller
segments.en: SpaceX 说，这样晶体长得更小、

segments.zh: and more uniform.
Same idea for tissue grown from stem cells,
and new materials for chips.
segments.en: 做芯片的新材料，也是这个道理。

segments.zh: Saucy keeps the experiments plugged in: one kilowatt of power,
segments.en: 小碟让实验一直通着电：一千瓦，

segments.zh: and a live link through Starlink.
segments.en: 还能通过星链实时联网。

segments.zh: Twist three, the hardest part:
coming home.
Saucy slams into the air at orbital speed,
segments.en: 小碟用轨道速度一头扎进大气，

segments.zh: and the air in front gets crushed and blazing hot.
segments.en: 前面的空气被压得滚烫。

segments.zh: Our guess: its wide, flat belly
segments.en: 我们猜：它又宽又扁的肚皮，

segments.zh: works as a brake and a shield.
It has flown twice,
once in June and again in October.
Reports say three paying missions are already signed.
segments.en: 据报道，已经签了三单商业任务；

segments.zh: The name comes from Starship, which would carry them.
segments.en: 名字里的 Star，来自要拉它们的星舰。

segments.zh: Fine print: there is no price yet,
so nobody knows how cheap affordable really is.
And whether space-grown medicine pays off
is still an open bet.
segments.en: 也还是个没揭晓的赌局。

segments.zh: Also, if you are hoping to ride along:
it is about seventy five centimeters tall. You will not fit.
segments.en: 它只有七十五厘米高，装不下你。

segments.zh: So why does everything float in orbit?
segments.en: 所以，轨道上的东西凭啥飘？

segments.zh: Not because gravity is gone.
Because everything is falling together,
and always missing the ground.
SpaceX is not selling zero gravity.
It is selling a very, very long fall.
segments.en: 是一次非常、非常长的坠落。
